blocks.text: Ten years is a long time. It encompasses a multitude of changes and transformations in the landscape of taste, culture, and identity. Beauty standards evolve into something unrecognizable. Design undergoes a transmutation that could be a complete one-eighty of what it once was. So in the ever-shifting sands of fashion and design, how does one hope to achieve longevity? For Ia Coca, it simply requires two things: authenticity and focus. At only 25 years young, Ia Coca graduated from an intensive course at the Fashion Institute of Design and Arts. He cinched the top award his batch, the Designer of the […]...
